svg.title: Kanayama Station — JR
svg.desc: English north-up schematic. The 1F concourse is shown separately from the lower JR platforms. Two elevators link the JR paid concourse to Chuo Line platforms 1 and 2 and Tokaido Line platforms 3 and 4. Includes escalators, stairs, accessible toilet inside the JR gates, coin lockers outside the gates, and transfer directions.
